faces.name: Season of the Bold
faces.oracleText:
Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.
{P} — Create a tapped Treasure token.
{P}{P} — Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play them.
{P}{P}{P} — Until the end of your next turn, whenever you cast a spell, Season of the Bold deals 2 damage to up to one target creature.

faces.name: Season of the Burrow
faces.oracleText:
Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.
{P} — Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token.
{P}{P} — Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller draws a card.
{P}{P}{P} — Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with an indestructible counter on it.

faces.name: Season of the Witch
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this enchantment unless you pay 2 life.
At the beginning of the end step, destroy all untapped creatures that didn't attack this turn, except for creatures that couldn't attack.

faces.name: Season of Weaving
faces.oracleText:
Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.
{P} — Draw a card.
{P}{P} — Choose an artifact or creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of it.
{P}{P}{P} — Return each nonland, nontoken permanent to its owner's hand.

faces.name: Season's Beatings
faces.oracleText: Family gathering — Each creature target player controls deals damage equal to its power to another random creature that player controls.

faces.name: Seasons Past
faces.oracleText: Return any number of cards with different mana values from your graveyard to your hand. Put Seasons Past on the bottom of its owner's library.

faces.name: Sea Spirit
faces.oracleText: {U}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
